reviews.text: They are simply awesome
Thanks so much, Jonathan, and be sure to follow us @caninesocialclub on Instagram!

Canine Social Club has been incredible for my dog Augie. He gets so excited the moment he realizes where we're headed.

The staff knows him so well, and it's obvious how much affection and care they show him every time he's there. We truly appreciate the entire team and the way they treat Augie like one of their own.

Over the years we've been going there, Samir has continuously improved and expanded the facility. I know Augie loves the outdoor area from the photos they share. All the improvements they've made reaffirm my belief that Samir truly has the dogs' best interests at heart.

When I need to board Augie, I have complete peace of mind knowing he's being looked after by people who genuinely care about him. We absolutely love the team at Canine Social Club and couldn't recommend them more.

I found CSC online since I was coming in from out of state and needed to board my dog for a couple of days. The staff was very friendly and helpful both on the phone and in person. However, when  I arrived, the first concern was stench of urine.The whole place reeks of urine. Also, they wouldn’t let me in the facility where the animals are kept. They gave me one brief peek inside and I saw small crates stacked two high. They were appropriate for the size of animal, but way too small for my dog. When I mentioned bringing in my dog’s bed and other items, they balked, but eventually relented. I had visited two other facilities and boarded other dogs elsewhere. Never did they smell, I was always welcomed to tour the entire facility and encouraged to bring my dog’s bed and other comfort items. I raised concerns, but was reassured that he would have a large suite. I was in a bind but still almost backed out. The only reason I went ahead with boarding was the story of the dog who “ran away to daycare.” They did send me one update with three photos and a “temperament evaluation.” It was very minimal and nothing like other temperament assessments I have seen before. My dog did not look happy or engaged in any of the photos. When I picked up my dog, his bed was covered in another dog’s fur and it reeked of urine. This was a brand new dog bed I had just taken out of the box right before we left home. In hindsight, I wish I had made a different decision.
Thanks so much, Cecilia, we really appreciate the kind review and hope to see you again soon. Follow us @caninesocialclub on Instagram!

Me and my fiancé are new dog owners and literally this place is the best thing that’s ever happened to us. They helped us so much. They put our mind at ease at all Times our dog loves being there he runs to the place when we show up everyone so so friendly it is literally the greatest place. I have found as a dog owner. Thank you so much.
I love Canine Social Club!  They take excellent care of my dog. She loves going there. She gets excited when I tell her she’s going to “puppy school”
Thanks Peter, we're so glad your pup had a great time with us, and we'd love to see you again soon, so follow us @caninesocialclub on Instagram!

After 2 years, I am very happy to share that Canine Social Club is still a great place for daycare, boarding, and grooming! Our reluctant rescue mentioned below has grown in confidence due in large part, I believe, from her weekly visits to Canine Social Club daycare. Our 13-year-old used to lose weight when boarded before coming to Canine Social Club. Now she doesn't drop a pound!  My dogs are very comfortable in their home away from home and I enjoy the comfort of knowing they're in good hands.

2 years ago...

From the ease of registering and booking online to the front door greeting, we and our dogs had a great start for our first visit to Canine Social Club. The update with pictures was a nice touch. My furry fiends were clean, happy and tired when I arrived to pick them up. Our shy and reluctant rescue of 4 months was not distressed at all by her stay, my biggest concern. The staff was kind, caring, and professional. Looking forward to future boardings and daycare.
Thanks so much for the five star review, Brian, be sure to follow us @caninesocialclub on Instagram!
Thanks so much, CJ! We're really glad your pup had a great time with us, and we'd love to see you on Instagram! @caninesocialclub

OMG… I LOVE Canine Social Club 💙💙💙 Currently, I have brought Fynnigan, my 2 year old Cavapoo to be groomed (and pampered) by Thomas who transforms him from a shaggy pup into a divinely handsome little boy 💙 He is patient and kind and really seems to “love “ him 💙 I have the utmost regard for his grooming talents!
Additionally, Jorge, who is at the front, has been amazing! Not only is he kind and loving, he has taken the time to remember and honor my Cocker Spaniel, Cooper, who was also a recipient of the exquisite care at Canine Social Club, and who we had to return to God 2 years ago 😔 Jorge is not only loving, he joyously helps me put Fynnigan into his car seat when we leave… he also kisses him goodbye until the next time 💙
I so highly recommend Canine Social Club to everyone who cherishes and loves their fur babies… they will be treated with love and patience and kindness… as will their “parents “. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

I board my dog here 2 or 3 times a year, for a week or so, and booking online has always been simple and easy. Same for drop-off and pick-up - the staff always seem to know what they're doing and handle everything efficiently and with pleasant attitudes. I appreciate that the process has always been smooth and our dog always seems content. She has anxiety at home AND gets car-sick, but she always seems happy to be at Canine Social Club when we drop her off - she doesn't resist at all. They also post pictures and videos with a brief "report card" so that we can see she's doing well.
So happy I found this facility after recently moving here. They are friendly, professional, and affordable. Olive is excited when I tell her when we are headed there.
Each and every groom by Thomas is fantastic. The gentlemen is a true artist!
My dog Molly had a bath and nail trim today at Canine Social Club. They did a beautiful job, she looks and smells great.

My dog Simba loves to go to the Canine Social Club. He is very excited each time I take him to the daycare.
The people are extremely friendly and love dogs.
I highly recommend the Canine Social Club for your dog.
Thanks so much, Elvira, we really appreciate the love and hope to see you again soon, follow us @caninesocialclub on Instagram!
Our dog loves this place. It is clean and plenty of friendly staff with awesome vibes. Thank you for creating such a safe space for our loved ones.

I started taking my dog here a few months ago for daycare and he is so excited everyday when we pull up. He comes home tired and I can tell he played all day. The staff are so friendly and it is very affordable compared to other daycares in the area. Also boarded him for 10 days recently. We got pictures and a report card during the boarding to see how he was doing. Highly recommend!!!

The workers are great handlers and efficient working well with dogs behaviors. They keep me up to date on medical and packages expiring and have made accommodations for me at times in need. Thank you for taking such excellent care of Sadie.

We had a family trip planned for months and the place we used to take our pup to suddenly closed.  We were so stressed out trying to figure out where we would leave our pup without him feeling abandoned by being dropped off an entire new place for days.  I contacted my cousin who used to take his pup to Canine for years and after she passed they started to take their new puppy.  I was skeptical but we had no choice.  I called and the minute Shawn answered the phone I started to explain our situation and he was both a great listener and so empathic.  He assured us that Mago (our pup) would be well taken care of and they would give us updates on his stay.   We went to drop him off and were greeted by Shawn and another young man I can’t remember his name but he also was so nice and willing to help.  Meeting them in person was such a relief because I could tell these are great people that love animals.  Mago stayed for a week and we called to check and vice versa.   When we picked up Mago he was happy and calm which confirmed he had a good stay.  I highly recommend Canine.  This is where we will be boarding our pup from now going forward.
Olive had a grooming session today and it was fabulous. Staff is so very friendly. Thank you!!

I have mixed feelings about this place. Been there a handful of times and I feel bad after every drop off because of how badly it smells. I worked at a dog boarding/daycare and grooming place as a teenager and there is no reason for the front reception area to smell so horrible. It makes me worried about the cleanliness throughout the facility. Staff are really nice, their portal is great, it is a hit or miss if you will get any pictures or report card, and parking for pick up and dropoff is a challenge.

Thank you for taking such good care of my dog, with so much love, patience, and dedication. Your talent not only makes him look beautiful, but also makes him feel comfortable and loved. I appreciate the love and attention you give him on every visit. You are an excellent groomer! Thank you. On behalf of Nilo
Best place for daycare and boarding! It’s great to have people like the folks at Canine Social Club who you trust with your family member!
Dog was happy after the haircut.

We have been going to Canine Social for three years and absolutely love it. They take such great care of him whether it’s boarding or daycare! I say daycare and Finn runs to the door. He is so excited to go see all of his friends, both human and Canine! And best of all he comes home tired from a day of fun.

Such a friendly and reliable place! I’ve been taking my dog Baz here for almost the whole time I’ve owned him, and the folks at Canine Social know him personally and know his quirks to look out for. The one time there was a small mistake with his grooming (forgetting a sanitary trim along with his bath) they called me immediately and offered a free redo. I recommend them to everyone at the dog park.
The very best place for daycare and boarding.

I have been bringing my dog to canine social club for years now and only have had the most positive experiences with all staff I’ve interacted with. My pug cochineal screams out of excitement even when I just say she’s going there for vacation.
Thanks so much, Triple, we really appreciate the kind words and hope to see you again soon. Follow us @caninesocialclub on Instagram!
I have been coming here for some time now. Julia is amazing at grooming my mini poodle. She always does a great job and styles it perfectly! I definitely recommend seeing Julia!

I was nervous, my pup can be a handful.  He loves it at Canine Social Club.  He is in daycare 2x a week so when I board him in June he will be familiar and well taken care of.  I feel so much better knowing he is going to be happy.
I called to inquire and visit before using the services for our dogs. The guy was so rude, cut me off, said they are too busy & due to having dogs who are not human friendly can't show the facility.
Thanks so much for the review, Genie! Be sure to follow us @caninesocialclub on Instagram!

My dog Gemma goes to daycare while I’m at work and is always excited to get in the car to go. The staff seems to care a lot about the dogs individually and I love that they separate dogs by size. Highly recommend for daycare!

They had such great communication and were very kind to my Chloe. It was her first time boarding and I was a bit nervous, but they went out of their way to assure me she was in great hands. I also appreciate the groomer as well. I am extremely happy with the canine social club! Thank you!

Our dog regularly came home from this place smelling like chemicals which gave me hives.  Our dog came home with scrapes on his paws and nose with no explanation.  One time they tried to send him home with us without his collar.  The final straw was when our dog came home with a gash in his ear this place didn’t even know he suffered.  For your sake and your dog’s, take your business elsewhere.
Thanks so much Kelsey! We really appreciate you taking the time to leave a review. Check us out on Instagram! @caninesocialclub
Thanks so much Chris, we're glad you had a great experience and would love to have you follow us on Instagram! @caninesocialclub

The staff is great, the groomer is affordable and does a great job, and most importantly, my dog absolutely loves coming here. He NEVER pulls on the leash as hard as he does when we round the corner to enter the building. They even remember my boy just by looking at him. Highly recommend this place for doggy daycare or grooming. Ive never boarded my guy there but given how good they are at daycare and grooming, Im assuming that would also be a good eexperience for your pup!
We have been clients of CSC for over  3years.  Our greyhound always is treated well and comes home exhausted!   Super easy for daycare drop offs and boarding.  The staff is awesome !!!
Been bringing my dog here for the past 7 years for social time, grooming and the occasional boarding.  Everyone is helpful and friendly.  Thomas does a fantastic groom.  We love canine social.
My dog loves coming to CSC! I’m fairly certain he goes for the people vs the canine friends but either way he’s excited when we pull up.
We've had Walter groomed many times. Always pleased with the job!

Do not recommend.

Very little information was provided about the boarding process, and we were not allowed to see where our dogs would be sleeping. Huge red flag.

At drop-off, our dogs were literally taken away before we could even say goodbye. No explanation, no reassurance—just rushed and uncomfortable.

Before arrival, I called to confirm a credit card was on file and was told it was. That turned out to be false. Despite their own mistake, both my partner and I received EIGHT calls in less than 24 hours attempting to collect payment. Excessive, aggressive, and unprofessional.

To make matters worse, when our neighbor helped with pickup, they experienced the same billing confusion—being told a card was on file, then suddenly it wasn’t, blamed on a “computer glitch,” after being asked how they wanted to pay. Clearly not a one-off issue.

On top of all that, not all of our dogs’ belongings were returned.

Between the lack of transparency, mishandling of pets, repeated billing issues, and poor communication, this was a stressful and frustrating experience. Look elsewhere if you value professionalism and peace of mind.
Hey John, thanks so much for the five stars! We really appreciate the love. Follow us on Instagram! @caninesocialclub
Thomas and Canine Social Club are the best. The grooming service is fantastic. I cannot thank Thomas and Canine Social Club enough for taking care of my dog!
My dog who is very nervous had a really good time at canine social club.  That staff were very good with him
Thanks so much for the five stars, Stefanie. We really appreciate you! Follow us on Instagram! @caninesocialclub

My dog was 9 days on Boarding and he seemed had a blast. Everybody were very kind and helpful. We received a report card during our travel. He definitely was take care with love.
We're going to go back soon.
Very nice staff, dog grooming was punctual and efficient.
Thanks so much, Caroline! We're happy you had a great experience with us. Would love for you to check us out on Instagram @caninesocialclub for more cute dog content and updates.

I have a senior Pittie and she LOVES the
Staff at Canine Social Club.

recently recued a pup and wanted to help socialize him once a week or if daycare was right for him. Canine Social was the place to be!! He loved it, enjoyed some add on spa services and had a fully happy pup after a long work day. Also, received a mid-day report with photos to solidify my choice in facilities to care for my furbaby, along with all the happy pet parents I have met thus far. Highly recommend and even purchased a pack of days to treat my pup to a weekly treat of daycare at his club!
Tigger loved how she looks after her mani pedi. The groomer is gentle and loving.
Thank you, Abe, for your fantastic feedback. Connect with us on Instagram! @caninesocialclub

Canine Social Club were able to fit in our pup last minute when we realized we needed to be away for a day. She had a great first overnight, and I appreciate the positive feedback from the team at pick up.
Brought my two Yorkies and they look fabulous! Will be coming here in the future. Thank you so much for taking care of my fur babies♥️

Hey Melanie, thanks so much for the five stars! We’re glad you had a great experience with Canine Social Club. Looking forward to seeing you and your furry friend again soon. Connect with us on Instagram! @caninesocialclub

I travel with a lot of peace ☮️ knowing Canine Social Club has my German shepherd. They do a consistent phenomenal job caring for Hudson when I’m away and or when he is in daycare or walking. I will only use this business for my dog needs. I also love the new upgrades to the business. It matches the quality of service they have provided over the years. Keep up the good work and Thank you 🙏🏽
Our pup Maya has participated in doggie daycare and boarded many times at Canine Social Club. She loves playing and staying there! The staff are great!
Thanks so much for the great review, Diana! We’re glad you’re happy with us and look forward to welcoming you and your pup back soon. Connect with us on Instagram! @caninesocialclub
They took excellent care of our dog!
We love Canine Social Club!!! Stella has been going there for five years. She is so loved there ❤️
Thanks so much for the review, Rengin! We're happy to hear you had a great experience with us. Hope to see you and your pup again soon. Follow us on Instagram! @caninesocialclub
Friendly staff, great setup
We primarily use the boarding services, and have been very happy with the service and friendliness of the staff.

Took my doodle here for the first time yesterday. He has never been to doggy daycare before, so I was nervous. I met 4 different staff members between drop off and pick up, and all were amazing! They send a report card with a photo midday that was so cute and put me at ease. We will definitely be regulars!

This was our first time getting groomed at Canine Social Club and I was extremely satisfied! Thomas did a great job trimming my dog's fur in all the right places and did a better job than our previous groomer did! Easy to make an appointment online and very reasonable prices for the grooming services that they offer. We will be returning for future grooming!
Margo always comes home happy and tired.
Thanks for the 5 stars, Brittany! We appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience.

Had a great experience here. I brought my dog in early for a temperament test, where they first introduced her to the socializing area alone and then gradually brought in their regular dogs to assess how well she interacted. She stayed for the day, and I received a detailed mid-day report card saying she passed “with flying colors”—plus a couple of photos where she looked genuinely happy. When I picked her up that evening, she was thrilled to see me but clearly worn out (which I took as a very good sign). She came home, ate dinner, and slept soundly through the night. I’m heading out of town soon and feel totally confident leaving her in their care.
we are so incredible happy with our experience at canine social club. they take special care with our sweet deaf puppy - he is always so happy to be dropped off, and he comes home totally exhausted!

My dog looks so handsome every time after his appointment! He also comes back content and not scared compared to petsmart! I can tell they take good care of him and they get the job done very well! Thank you so much!

Staff was friendly, courteous, caring and very professional. They provided an update on our pup during the day, since it was our first time trying out the facility. It was a great experience, and we will continue to take our pup there.

We’ve been using this boarding facility for several years and, up until recently, have been generally satisfied. However, during our last two visits, our dog came home soaked in urine. We even brought up our concerns with the staff before her most recent stay, hoping it would be addressed—but unfortunately, we picked her up today and she was once again covered in urine. Given this repeated issue, we’re done with this place.  I would seriously question any of the other recent 5 star reviews.
We love how fast and efficient our grooming appts are.
We love Canine Social Club!! They take such good care of Booker, I’m so glad we started taking him there. Booker loves it too, he’s always so excited to get inside and play!! Thanks CSC!!

We left our 6-month-old puppy at CSC for 9 days while we were out of the country, based on a recommendation. When we arrived, the lobby smelled, but I brushed it off—dogs are smelly. What threw me off was how someone just came out of the back, took our pup without a word, and disappeared. When we asked to see her again before leaving, the front desk guy said, “Sorry, people aren’t allowed back there because of the dogs.” It felt weird, like they were hiding something.

Since my dog needs a lot of grooming, I asked for a midweek brush-out and nail trim. They added it, apparently for free. We got photos once during the week—she looked happy. A few days later, we asked for more and got some the next day (right after her supposed brush-out). She still looked happy, but I know what my dog looks like after being brushed, and she definitely wasn’t. I doubt they did it.

When we picked her up, they casually mentioned she had bad diarrhea toward the end of her stay, saying, “She must’ve gotten into something,” but gave no details. The next day, I texted the owner asking when it started—he just said, “Saturday the 15th. Hope she feels better soon!” It’s been five days, and her appetite and stool still aren’t normal, so now we have to take her to the vet.

When I brushed her at home, I found tons of mats in her fur, tangles everywhere, and dried poop stuck to her. She’s been dragging her butt on the floor, and no matter what we do, we can’t get the mess off. Now, on top of the vet visit, we have to rush her to the groomer. To make things worse, she’s regressed in potty training. I’ve since read reviews saying they let dogs go to the bathroom indoors—suddenly, it all makes sense.

My pup seemed to have fun and make friends, but the lack of cleanliness, transparency, and proper care means we won’t be coming back—not even for daycare.

This is where we take our dog Elvira for daycare and boarding when needed, and she loves it here! We feel very comfortable sending her here and know she is in good hands, and will return home tired from playing all day.

My dog Sadie is a huge challenge – she's a puppy mill survivor and extremely anxious. She went in with matted hair and a fair amount of dirt and came out with a wonderful cut . I am grateful that they were willing to be challenged by her and will certainly go again.
Canine Social Club is fantastic! The staff is caring, the facility is clean, and my coonhound comes home happy and tired. Highly recommend!

I brought my energetic pup here and everyone was amazing and made the whole process easy and smooth. They sent me a report card saying that Holi was getting along with everyone and had found a couple other dogs with her energy.
I will be bring holi back again soon and recommend canine social club

Frankie, my one year old pup who had never been to daycare, had a great time at canine social club. It was quick and easy to get him signed up, drop off and pick up equally easy. And I got a message midday about how he was doing, with pictures! Definitely recommend.

This place is amazing! The staff is so kind, sweet and knowledgeable. Anytime. Anytime my dog is there for the day. He comes home exhausted. And he has a great friends because of the plethora of dogs that they have there! I recommend it to anyone who's looking for daycare for their dogs.

Our dog loves going to daycare at Canine Social Club!  He runs to the car everyday and waits to get in the car.

The staff are wonderful, helpful and friendly.  Highly recommend this club!

Our dogs love coming here and it’s a great value.  The staff all know our dogs and it seems like there is little turnover so it’s a lot of familiar faces for the owners and the dogs, which is nice.  I also love that they have weekend daycare hours.

Canine Social Club always takes great care of our pups—We have a senior dog who needs meds and can’t play too hard anymore and a younger dog (5) who needs to get her energy out and socialize, and I trust CSC to take good care of their particular needs and love on my dogs when I can’t be with them. Love this place!
Reasonably priced

Really nice people at this place. Kimber did a great job with my dog's full service package. He smelled great and didn't look like a little monster anymore. The prices are also amazing for the service they offer.

My Dexter always rushes to get to the Club in the morning and leaves looking like he had a good time and is ready for a nap to rest up.  The staff is stellar and I always know Dexter is in good hands while he is at the Club.

Unlike many others, as the Canine Social Club business has grown the experience has remained personal and loving.  I recently brought my very anxious dog for daycare, and the staff there helped make him comfortable and provided updates throughout the day, including pictures!, and a thorough report of his day.  The staff are genuinely happy to be there and treat pets and humans with care and respect.

My dog loves coming here! He has been coming to the Canine Club since he was a puppy to play. The staff is great and the facility is clean. I feel at ease leaving my dog knowing that he will taken care of and he will be having fun.

Definitely bringing my dog back! Staff was friendly and personable. I They also have a very seamless drop off and pick up system And they didn’t lose any of my dog’ belongings, which has definitely happened before.

I was that dog mom that couldn't wait for the noon report and called checking up on my baby on her 1st day...they were so understanding and eased my nerves letting me know how she was doing and telling me it's OK. Kudos to this crew 👏 💪🤘🐾🐶 …
I love this place sm!!! My dog is obsessed and I can tell they love having her :) they provide a great service.
We were very happy with our dog’s boarding experience. She was so tired after returning home💕 …

My 7 months pup was so happy and excited when I picked him up. He couldn’t wait to go back today!!!
The staff is so responsive and helpful being my first time taking my fur baby to daycare.

Canine Social Club is the best. I have a very active 2 year old cattle dog, and she always comes home happy and exhausted. You can tell the people there genuinely love dogs and are so sweet. So thankful to have such a great place nearby!
So wonderful, timely, and professional. My dog came here for grooming and looks so good. Will definitely be back!

Best place I could have taken my puppy for her first daycare session. The staff were very friendly and kept me updated on my dog throughout the day and provided video updates. Would strong recommend to anyone

We have brought our puppy here over 15 times, and have never had a bad experience. So many of the workers know our boy by name and love seeing him.
It’s affordable and flexible for daycare and I definitely recommend it.

That being said, this place does not smell very good. Every time we pick up our dog, we have to give him a bath because of how bad he smells. He stinks up the whole car on the way home too. Just be aware that while your dog will likely LOVE this place, you will not love the smell.
Been taking my boy to Canine Social Club for years.  They always take such good care of Henry and do a great job every time.  Today he got a little mowhawk.
Our dog loves Canine Social. She’s always excited to go to daycare and the staff are always helpful. Big bonus that they offer grooming. Would highly recommend!

My Aussie has been going to weekly daycare and been boarded overnight. All of the staff is great and he is very happy (and tired!) after a day there. I love the long hours and flexible drop off and pickup times!! Can’t recommend it enough!!
Always hospitable and on top of it.
Priscilla loves going here

We adopted a new dog and weren’t sure about his history or interactions. The staff were so kind, explained everything that would happen and gave a “report card” with pictures of his smiling face! Also they are really easy to reach and responsive.

My very anxious rescue Saki had a wonderful stay at Canine Social Club! It was our first time trying out a Chicago-based boarder and I look forward to my pupper coming back, soon! I loved the report card and pictures, such a comforting touch. Great work, CSC.

I took my very young and small dachshund puppy, Kiwi, to Canine Social Club as her first experience with daycare. They took excellent care of her and made sure to pace her due to her size. She absolutely loved daycare and this helped so much with her socialization skills, as well as eased my anxiety of leaving my new puppy at daycare when I went back to work. Although our time here was short lived and we moved away, I would recommend Canine Social Club a million times over again. The staff was so kind and loving towards Kiwi, and I know she loved them just as much! We plan on coming back for any grooming needs whenever we get the chance and keeping in touch!
